comments.body: This will become Weekend Bonus Reward from 6th March - 8th May. Definitely worth to do since the ticket itself contains 10x Custom Tailoring Tools (similar like Master Tailoring Tools but this gives +10 durability) and 10x Master Craftsman's Special Repair Tools (repair ship sail by 1 dura as far as i can remember), there is always a thing need to be fixed, right..
